identity_reason: it is invisible by definition, so there is no form
concept: Text for a screen reader that a sighted reader does not need, so a meaning carried by an icon or a colour is also said in words (P6).

root.why: off screen for the eye, in the accessibility tree for a screen reader

focusable.why: a skip link comes back into view while it has focus

focus-within.why: a focused skip link is shown so a keyboard user sees where they are

focus.why: the same, when the hidden element itself takes focus
